page.overview:
Who is Mupp?

Mupp is a character created by Mark McLaughlin and Michael Sheehan, Jr. for their Egyptian Cthulhu Mythos stories.

Severely deformed from birth - as a result of interference from the Outer God Nyarlathotep at the time of conception - Mupp is described as "large, red-faced … with an oversized skull, a cleft lip, a slight chin, a stunted arm, and overly large, malformed hips. His crooked spine ended in a vestigial tail. His left foot resembled the flipper of a turtle, while his other foot and hands all featured the wrong numbers of fingers and toes." His most distinctive feature is that he is a cyclops, with a "huge single eye nestled above … flaring cheekbones. Even at birth, a thick arc of black brow curved over the eye, which regarded the world with seething wrath. The iris of this eye was composed of three reddish-gold lobes, centered around the irregular black circle of the pupil."

He is also a gifted magic user with the ability to cause blood to gush from the ears of others with but a whisper, see in total darkness, and project blasts of green fire from his hands.

Despite being born to the pharaoh Tutankhamen, Mupp's hideous appearance meant that he was exiled to the catacombs beneath the royal palace. There, he formed his own cult to Nyarlathotep before one day stumbling across the undying followers of Azathoth. He learned from these shrivelled mummies how to reanimate the dead, and commanded them to bring him more corpses with which to create his own army. However, before his plans could come to fruition, he was slain by the creature Setek after displaying a burst of childish petulance.
